story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 8 — Archive Scribe Engine / Nimera Joins
director_rule: Provide the hostile Scribe Engine situation, the current four-person provisional grouping, the hard recruitment outcome, and the reveal boundaries. Do not script a recruitment conversation, require anyone to explain Nimera's freedom to choose, or require Nimera to summarize why she joins.

scene_context.location: deeper Old City archive immediately beyond the reopened Ancient barrier
scene_context.situation: Reopening the route has reconnected active archive machinery. A Scribe Engine shifts into dangerous enforcement behavior while Nimera is already moving with Cyanis, Ilyra and Torren provisionally. Nimera is a practiced Cardweaver and combat-capable, but not yet a permanent party member.
scene_context.card_state: Cyanis carries the abnormal green-and-gold Card, still unclassified
scene_context.presentation: short pre-fight trigger, one mandatory battle, concise natural aftermath

hard_outcomes: The Archive Scribe Engine becomes hostile as a procedural Ancient archive/enforcement mechanism, not a speaking villain.
Nimera enters the battle voluntarily and demonstrates Cardweaver, Conduit and Card-based combat competence.
The first four-person battle formation is Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren and Nimera.
The Scribe Engine is disabled locally without a large explosion or broad Archive shutdown.

Afterward, Nimera has enough direct evidence from the machine, Cyanis's Card and the permitted seal material to judge that deeper Archive evidence is worth pursuing, while still refusing unsupported Card classifications or a seal solution.
Nimera's intention to continue with the group becomes obvious through natural behavior and dialogue rather than an explanatory recruitment speech.
By the end of the beat Nimera Pellan is a permanent party member and the active permanent party is Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren and Nimera.
The scene hands into Beat 9 deeper four-person archive exploration.
knowledge_and_reveal_boundaries: No Last Sentinel wording or identity.
No confirmed bearer or ownership status.
No proof the Card caused the Scribe Engine activation.
No proof the Card, Scribe Engine and royal seal share one magical system.
No royal-seal culprit or exact mechanism.
No Cresthaven reveal or future subclass access.
